title: AI Smart Agriculture
quote: 🌱 Healthy soil, healthy crops, prosperous farmers.
disclaimerText: This crop recommendation is generated using AI based on soil parameters, weather conditions, and soil type. Farmers are advised to obtain a Soil Health Card from an authorized soil testing laboratory before using this recommendation. The N, P, K, and pH values should preferably come from a recent soil test report. Results may be less accurate if estimated values are used. Always consult local agricultural experts before making final cultivation decisions.
